description: This Java source file defines an immutable class `ImmutableJsonWebToken` which implements the `JsonWebToken` interface. It provides methods to create JWT instances from authorization headers or token strings, parses authorization header formats, and overrides methods for equality, hashing, and string representation.

classes.name: ImmutableJsonWebToken
classes.description: Immutable implementation of a JSON Web Token, providing mechanisms to parse authorization headers, extract tokens, and represent JWTs with relevant subject claims.

methods.name: fromAuthorization
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableJsonWebToken instance from an authorization header string by extracting the token part.

methods.name: getTokenFromAuthorizationString
methods.description: Parses the authorization header string to extract the actual token, ensuring proper format and throwing exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: fromToken
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableJsonWebToken instance from a raw token string after validation.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the list of authorization subjects associated with the token.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals() to compare JWT instances based on their token and subject list.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode() for consistent hashing based on token and subjects.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the JWT object.
